title: Platform-specific usage: FileMaker Go (iOS)
description: Scripts in scope that are built FOR FileMaker Go (iOS): steps that run exclusively on iOS (derived from the Claris step-compatibility table) plus curated iOS-dedicated functions — called directly or reached through custom functions (callable everywhere, meaningful results only on iOS; fm_spec function_platform_affinity, reference 1.12.0+). Inventory, not defects — findings are neutral properties, never errors. The dashboard view is the iOS usage profile of the solution: binding KPIs, a feature breakdown (which iOS features - sensors, location, beacons, media - bind how many scripts) and the script list.
author: fm-lab rules

rule.rationale: Platform binding is an inventory statement: these scripts use features that only work (exclusive steps) or only make sense (dedicated functions) on FileMaker Go (iOS). That is a property of the script, not a defect — it makes the iOS share of a solution visible.
rule.remediation: Nothing to fix. Use the inventory to identify the iOS layer of the solution; to see where these scripts would fail elsewhere, run the compatibility aspect of the other target environments.

defaultResult.name: platform_specific_scripts
defaultResult.meaning: Scripts in scope that use FileMaker Go (iOS)-specific features (exclusive steps or dedicated functions)
